entries.checked_passage: Printed p. 4 records Theorem 2, the H=1 case, with the positive coprime rational numerator and denominator and strict approximation bound inherited from Theorem 1. It gives the von Mangoldt quadratic prefix bound N^(1+epsilon)(q^−1+N^−1/2+qN^−2)^(1/4).

entries.source_locator: §1, (1.1) and theorem, printed pp. 652–653 / PDF pp. 1–2
entries.identity_check: English translation, 2018, Sbornik: Mathematics 209(5), 652–659, 10.1070/SM8939. Russian original Matematicheskii Sbornik 209(5), 54–61, 10.4213/sm8939, is the same work. The 2019 preprint arXiv:1911.09981 is not this translation.
entries.checked_passage: Remote English primary PDF pp. 652–653. Formula (1.1) uses the homogeneous inverse residue with von Mangoldt weight. For q>q0(epsilon), unit a and q^(7/10+epsilon)≤X≤q, the estimate is X(q^7 X^−10)^(1/74)q^epsilon up to an implied constant.
